header.productTitle: Wisdom Mouthcare Organizer and UV Cleanser
header.superHtml:
Wisdom, aka Mama Turbo, is here to ensure all mouth systems are a-go. Just like other super moms, she is a multi-tasking master. Not only does Wisdom dispense mouthpaste, but her wings store and protect Turbo Twins mouthbrushes (or any other SuperMouth mouthbrushes) from sink germs while UV lights blast off harmful bacteria and cleanse brush heads after each use. Wisdom also sings sweet lullabies to her babies Mini Turbo and Turbo Jr. (sold separately), and your child with four two-minute SuperMouth songs (the recommended time for brushing). Watching kids fulfill their brushing mission makes this mama’s heart skip a beat — or rather, stay in beat — with their favorite toothy tune as they brush.

  • Toothpaste Dispenser: Works with any SuperMouth toothpaste, ensuring a hassle-free brushing routine.
  • Brush Storage: Provides storage for both Turbo Twins mouthbrushes or any other SuperMouth mouthbrushes.
  • Germ Protection: Offers covered protection from sink germs for mouthbrush heads.
  • UV Cleansing: UV system in wings activates for nine minutes, cleansing bristles.
  • Multi-Function Body: Wisdom’s body turns into a rinse cup for added convenience.
  • Brushing Songs: Four two-minute brushing songs sync to the rhythm of Wisdom’s flashing heart, encouraging proper brushing habits.
  • Music Availability: Full versions of the songs, along with the lyrics, can be found on all major online music stores under the album SuperMouth Brush Beats.

Elevate your child’s oral care routine with the enchanting and functional Wisdom, making every brushing session a fun and healthy mission!

FAQs
items.html:
What is Wisdom (aka Mama Turbo) and how does it work?
Wisdom, also known as Mama Turbo, is a children’s oral care organizer designed to make brushing fun and effective. It dispenses toothpaste, stores and protects SuperMouth toothbrushes, and uses UV lights to sanitize brush heads. Additionally, Wisdom plays four two-minute SuperMouth songs to encourage proper brushing habits, as recommended by dentists.
Does Wisdom work with all SuperMouth toothbrushes?
Yes, Wisdom is compatible with all SuperMouth toothbrushes, including Turbo Twins mouthbrushes.
How does the UV light system in Wisdom work?
Wisdom features two separate UV light systems in its wings, each activating for nine minutes to effectively blast off harmful bacteria and cleanse two brush heads simultaneously. This makes it ideal for kids with multiple brushes or for families with two children.
What songs does Wisdom play, and where can I find them?
Wisdom plays four two-minute SuperMouth songs to help children brush for the recommended time. The full versions of these songs, along with the lyrics, can be found on all major online music stores under the album SuperMouth Brush Beats.
How do I clean and maintain Wisdom?
Wisdom is designed to be easy to clean. The wings and body can be wiped down with a damp cloth. For detailed cleaning instructions, please refer to the user manual included with the product.
Can Wisdom be used by children of all ages?
Yes, Wisdom is suitable for children of all ages who use SuperMouth toothbrushes. The engaging songs and UV sanitization features make it a great addition to any child’s oral care routine.
What makes Wisdom different from other toothbrush holders?
Wisdom is not just a toothbrush holder; it’s a multi-functional oral care organizer. It dispenses toothpaste, sanitizes toothbrushes with two separate UV light systems, stores brushes safely, plays fun brushing songs, and even has a rinse cup feature, all designed to make brushing enjoyable and effective for children.
